query: Find NASA's official Mars Exploration Program page and summarize its purpose briefly using only official NASA sources.
raw_report:
## Executive Summary

NASA's official Mars Exploration Program (MEP) page resides at [science.nasa.gov/planetary-science/programs/mars-exploration/](https://science.nasa.gov/planetary-science/programs/mars-exploration/). Three official NASA pages consulted for this report — the MEP page itself, the public-facing [nasa.gov/mars](https://www.nasa.gov/mars/) hub, and the [Mars Science Laboratory / Curiosity mission page](https://www.nasa.gov/missions/mars-science-laboratory/) — are mutually consistent.

## Background

The program was formally established in 1993, a fact corroborated by secondary sources such as [Wikipedia's Mars Exploration Program article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mars_Exploration_Program).
